headline: Canada PM Courts EU Leaders in Montreal to Diversify Trade Beyond US
summary: Canada's prime minister hosted European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen and European Council President António Costa in Montreal to attract European investment and secure long-term buyers as the US share of Canadian trade declines.
why: Canada is heavily reliant on exports to the United States. Geopolitical realignments and trade diversification efforts with the European Union affect long-term supply agreements in energy, metals, and industrial goods.

impacts.name: Canada
impacts.why: Expanding bilateral commerce with the European Union reduces single-market export exposure.
